warnings.title: IDD21013.cap
warnings.text: Maximum temperatures in the mid thirties over the Tiwi Islands. Minimum temperatures in the mid twenties. Severe heatwave conditions have eased over the Arnhem district, and are expected to ease over the Tiwi Islands during the weekend before redeveloping by the middle of next week.
